pick.E1: stop at the first refinement (strict-cost order) with hit ratio >= tau
pick.sets: pick = even true-grain index, test = odd
pick.chosen_by: largest cut among tau with broken <= fixed on the pooled pick set; none: tau 0.80 (the seed test)

E2.second_tests: abs-T: h >= T for T in [0.6, 0.65, 0.7, 0.75, 0.8, 0.85]; nb-f: h >= f * neighbour's hit for f in [0.7, 0.8, 0.9]
E2.chosen_by: largest estimated cut among tests with broken <= fixed on the pick set; ties to the test that keeps fewer; none: E2 fails
